title.value: MII VS Microbiology LOINC Ontology General Microscopy By Technique

description.value: Proposal: LOINC codes of the microbiology request 'Microscopy: General microscopy — nominal finding by microscopy or staining technique', computed by ECL over the LOINC Ontology 2026-10-21. Nominal microscopic observation with an explicit microscopy or staining technique (Gram, Giemsa, acid-fast, light microscopy ...). Contains 664-3. Parts: LOINC enumeration (383, LOINC 2.83), LOINC Ontology observables without LOINC code (0), and the ECL as an intensional include.
